description: The fuel required: the airplane's own start, taxi and takeoff allowance (its profile's taxi_fuel_gal; taxi_gal null and left out of the fuel required where its profile has none, never a stock airplane's), the trip, the IFR alternate (14 CFR 91.167(a)(2)) and the reserve, 30 min by day and 45 at night under VFR (91.151(a)), and 45 where `night` is null (no departure time: night cannot be ruled out, so the larger is assumed), 45 under IFR (91.167(a)(3)); and the margin against the usable fuel; the margin is against the fuel in the tanks as the flight leaves (on_board_gal): full, the usable fuel, unless the pilot set their own (fill_gal: at the departure the fuel on board at engine start, at a stop what it is fuelled to, never under what the flight before left, left_gal; more than usable kept as set, with a warning); lands_with_gal is what it lands with, the next flight's left_gal.

profile.description: null is no airplane picked: the legs' courses, miles, altitudes and air, and every figure that needs an airplane null (the owner, 2026-11-09: "don't assume").

night.description: Whether the flight is at night (14 CFR 1.1, after the end of evening civil twilight); null where it has no departure time, which takes the night's 45-minute VFR reserve (91.151(a)(2)).

fill_gal.description: The pilot's own figure for the tanks as the flight leaves, gallons: at the departure the fuel on board at engine start, at a stop what it is fuelled to (0, no fuel bought); null, full.

left_gal.description: At a stop, what the flight before landed with (its lands_with_gal), which fuelling never takes from; null at the departure or where not known.

on_board_gal.description: The fuel in the tanks as the flight leaves, gallons; null with no airplane or no usable fuel known and none set.

lands_with_gal.description: The fuel it lands with: on_board_gal less the start and taxi allowance and the trip; null where either is not known.
